import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.games import make_game
from makemarket.provenance import receipt,file_sha256

path=Path('results/expansion/llama_midday_acquisition.json');assert not path.exists()
cohorts={}
for game in ('dice','cards'):
    raw=Path(f'results/expansion/raw/{game}/meta_llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct__text-only_.jsonl')
    data=raw.read_bytes();rows=[json.loads(line) for line in data.splitlines()]
    assert [r['seed'] for r in rows]==list(range(200,200+len(rows)))
    for row in rows:
        canonical=make_game(game).episode(row['seed'])
        assert row['game']==game and len(row['rounds'])==6 and row['value']==canonical.value
        assert [r['reveal'] for r in row['rounds']]==canonical.reveals
        cfg=row['provenance']['config'];assert cfg['model']=='meta/llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct'
        assert cfg['temperature']==.3 and cfg['max_tokens']==4096 and cfg['extra_body']=={}
    cohorts[game]={'episodes':len(rows),'canonical_games_verified':True,'file':str(raw),'observed_prefix_bytes':len(data),'observed_prefix_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'complete':len(rows)==200}
r={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'retain structural API acquisition progress without partial scores'},'NIM immutable deployment revision not exposed'),
    'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'cohorts':cohorts,'resume_plan':'results/expansion/llama_duplicate_retry_plan.json','resume_plan_sha256':file_sha256('results/expansion/llama_duplicate_retry_plan.json'),
    'scope':'Prefixes may continue to grow; hashes identify the exact captured bytes. No partial cohort or held-out aggregate is scored. Original four API models remain complete at 200/game.'}
path.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print({g:c['episodes'] for g,c in cohorts.items()})
